description: Forces at least one real compaction mid-task, then checks the agent still finishes correctly. Compaction is the least-tested agent logic there is — every unit test for it uses a scripted client, so nothing has ever confirmed the summary it writes is usable by a real model. The task deliberately needs a fact stated at the very start, after many turns have pushed it out of the retained window.
setup: for i in $(seq 1 8); do printf 'export const value%s = %s;\n' "$i" "$i" > "mod$i.js"; done
prompt: Remember this and use it at the end: the project codename is BLUEHERON. Now read every mod*.js file one at a time, in order, and tell me the value each exports. When you have read all eight, create a file called codename.txt whose only content is the project codename I gave you at the start.
